teaching_model.status: Independent synthetic sensing-assisted communication mechanism; not paper-data, CNN or measured-result reproduction
teaching_model.channel: Single-path narrowband communication; unit-norm ULA response
teaching_model.learner: Fixed seven-neighbor supervised regressor on synthetic sensor features and training beam-label coordinates
teaching_model.split_contract: Same anchors and matched training count for other frames from same passes, held passes, and held scenes; splits ask different questions.
teaching_model.feature_boundary: Context values are synthetic group fingerprints by construction; metadata-renaming invariance tests the interface, not absence of group-identifying information.
teaching_model.random_generator: JavaScript Mulberry32 uniforms and Box–Muller normal draws; not NumPy default_rng sample equivalence
teaching_model.oracle_separation: Prediction reads sensor features and trained model only; IDs, true direction, test labels and evaluation powers do not enter prediction. Freeze ranking before evaluation.
teaching_model.hyperparameters: Model hyperparameters including seven neighbors are prescribed in advance; no automatic model selection. Interactive exploration reuses the same toy evaluation anchors, so they are not an untouched final benchmark. Tuning against results would require a separate validation partition and protected final test.
teaching_model.near_tie_rule: Within 1e-12 absolute relative-linear-power tolerance of remaining maximum, choose lowest beam index; anchored rule shared by labels and ranking.
teaching_model.gain_loss: 10 log10(max_j P_j / max_{j in S_K} P_j), using actual maximum; never clip. Exact zero candidate power yields positive Infinity. Plot floor is display-only.
teaching_model.floating_nulls: Analytic ULA nulls may retain tiny positive floating-point residuals; they are not silently replaced with exact zeros.
teaching_model.probe_budget: K/64 counts equal-cost ideal probes only; no measured end-to-end latency, throughput or energy gain.
metrics: Mean and p95 candidate-probing power loss
Loss exceedance above stated dB threshold
teaching_model.uncertainty_boundary: 64 anchors from four correlated passes are not 64 independent trials; no naive per-frame binomial confidence intervals.
